pages.text_en: Emmy and Birch were mining deep in the caves. Emmy collected three diamonds and put them in her inventory.

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch were mining deep in the caves.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 正在洞穴深处挖矿。

sentences.text_en: Emmy collected three diamonds and put them in her inventory.
sentences.zh: Emmy 找到三颗钻石，把它们放进物品栏。

pages.text_en:
"Let's craft a diamond pickaxe,' Emmy said. "We could use it to mine anything!"
Byte pointed his nose at a dark oak tree and barked. "Good point, Byte. Emmy nodded. "We need wood to craft the pickaxe!"

sentences.text_en: "Let's craft a diamond pickaxe,' Emmy said.
sentences.zh: “我们来制作一把钻石镐吧，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "We could use it to mine anything!" Byte pointed his nose at a dark oak tree and barked.
sentences.zh: “有了它，我们什么都能挖！”Byte 把鼻子指向一棵深色橡树，并叫了起来。

sentences.text_en: "Good point, Byte.
sentences.zh: “说得好，Byte。”

sentences.text_en: "We need wood to craft the pickaxe!"
sentences.zh: “我们需要木头来制作镐子！”

pages.text_en:
Coming right up!" Birch said. He punched the tree. It broke apart into blocks of wood.
Emmy turned the blocks into oak planks and sticks. She used the planks to create a crafting table. "Now we can craft the diamond pickaxe!" she said.

sentences.text_en: Coming right up!" Birch said.
sentences.zh: “马上就来！”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: He punched the tree.
sentences.zh: 他用拳头打树。

sentences.zh: 树裂开，变成了一块块木头。

sentences.text_en: Emmy turned the blocks into oak planks and sticks.
sentences.zh: Emmy 把木块加工成橡木木板和木棍。

sentences.text_en: She used the planks to create a crafting table.
sentences.zh: 她用木板制作了一张工作台。

sentences.text_en: "Now we can craft the diamond pickaxe!" she said.
sentences.zh: “现在我们可以制作钻石镐了！”她说。

pages.text_en:
Birch looked around. There were dark oak trees everywhere. Their leaves were like a giant green roof covering the explorers.
"I think we've wandered into a dark forest!" Birch said. "Let's go exploring," Emmy said. Maybe they could gather some useful materials in there!

sentences.text_en: Birch looked around.
sentences.zh: Birch 环顾四周。

sentences.text_en: There were dark oak trees everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是深色橡树。

sentences.text_en: Their leaves were like a giant green roof covering the explorers.
sentences.zh: 树叶像一张巨大的绿色屋顶，遮住了探险者。

sentences.text_en: "I think we've wandered into a dark forest!" Birch said.
sentences.zh: “我觉得我们走进了一片黑森林！”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: "Let's go exploring," Emmy said.
sentences.zh: “我们进去探险吧，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: Maybe they could gather some useful materials in there!

pages.text_en: The building looked scary, but Emmy and Birch couldn't resist stepping inside.

sentences.text_en: The building looked scary, but Emmy and Birch couldn't resist stepping inside.
sentences.zh: 那座建筑看起来很吓人，但 Emmy 和 Birch 忍不住走了进去。

pages.text_en:
On the first floor, the hallways were long and winding. The red carpet on the floor looked so fancy. But on the second floor, they ran into an evoker!
The evoker conjured three vexes. The little flying mobs wielded iron swords. They flew down the hall at top speed!

sentences.text_en: On the first floor, the hallways were long and winding.
sentences.zh: 一楼的走廊又长又曲折。

sentences.text_en: The red carpet on the floor looked so fancy.
sentences.zh: 地上的红地毯看起来十分华丽。

sentences.text_en: But on the second floor, they ran into an evoker!
sentences.zh: 可是到了二楼，他们遇到了一只唤魔者！

sentences.text_en: The evoker conjured three vexes.
sentences.zh: 唤魔者召唤出三只恼鬼。

sentences.text_en: The little flying mobs wielded iron swords.
sentences.zh: 这些小型飞行生物手里拿着铁剑。

sentences.text_en: They flew down the hall at top speed!
sentences.zh: 它们以最快的速度沿走廊飞来！

pages.text_en:
Emmy swatted at the vexes. Byte chased them. Soon the vexes were defeated!
But the evoker was still there! Birch swung the diamond pickaxe. Just then, the evoker summoned a fang attack! A line of fangs came for Emmy, Birch, and Byte! They jumped just in time!

sentences.text_en: Emmy swatted at the vexes.
sentences.zh: Emmy 挥手拍打恼鬼。

sentences.text_en: Byte chased them.
sentences.zh: Byte 在后面追赶它们。

sentences.text_en: Soon the vexes were defeated!
sentences.zh: 很快，恼鬼们就被打败了！

sentences.text_en: But the evoker was still there!
sentences.zh: 但唤魔者还在！

sentences.text_en: Birch swung the diamond pickaxe.
sentences.zh: Birch 挥起了钻石镐。

sentences.text_en: Just then, the evoker summoned a fang attack!
sentences.zh: 就在这时，唤魔者召唤出了一次尖牙攻击！

sentences.text_en: A line of fangs came for Emmy, Birch, and Byte!
sentences.zh: 一排尖牙朝 Emmy、Birch 和 Byte 冲来！

sentences.text_en: They jumped just in time!
sentences.zh: 他们及时跳了起来！

pages.text_en:
"We've got to make a break for it," Emmy decided. "Let's search every inch of this mansion for something that will help us battle that evoker."
Birch nodded. The three friends fought their way out of the hall and kept going.

sentences.text_en: "We've got to make a break for it," Emmy decided.
sentences.zh: “我们得赶紧逃出去，”Emmy 决定道。

sentences.text_en: "Let's search every inch of this mansion for something that will help us battle that evoker." Birch nodded.
sentences.zh: “我们要把这座府邸的每个角落都找遍，看看有没有能帮助我们对付唤魔者的东西。”Birch 点了点头。

sentences.text_en: The three friends fought their way out of the hall and kept going.
sentences.zh: 三个朋友一路战斗着冲出走廊，继续向前。

pages.text_en:
When they saw a jail cell, Emmy opened the door. There was an allay inside, but there was also a vindicator!
The vindicator lunged at Birch with their iron axe. Birch fought bravely, but the pickaxe wasn't as good to use in battle as a sword. He couldn't defeat the illager, so the buddies ran away as fast as they could.

sentences.text_en: When they saw a jail cell, Emmy opened the door.
sentences.zh: 他们看见一间牢房时，Emmy 打开了门。

sentences.text_en: There was an allay inside, but there was also a vindicator!
sentences.zh: 里面有一只悦灵，但还有一只卫道士！

sentences.text_en: The vindicator lunged at Birch with their iron axe.
sentences.zh: 卫道士挥着铁斧，向 Birch 猛扑过去。

sentences.text_en: Birch fought bravely, but the pickaxe wasn't as good to use in battle as a sword.
sentences.zh: Birch 勇敢地战斗，但镐子不如剑适合用来打仗。

sentences.text_en: He couldn't defeat the illager, so the buddies ran away as fast as they could.
sentences.zh: 他打不过这名灾厄村民，于是伙伴们尽可能快地逃跑。

pages.text_en:
The vindicator was behind them, and they weren't alone. The evoker had caught up to them, too!
Emmy and Birch needed to escape, but there was a big, wide wall in their way. Birch had a plan. While he distracted the illagers, Emmy would mine her way through the wall. It was a good plan!

sentences.text_en: The vindicator was behind them, and they weren't alone.
sentences.zh: 卫道士就在他们身后，而且他们并不只是面对它。

sentences.text_en: The evoker had caught up to them, too!
sentences.zh: 唤魔者也追上来了！

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch needed to escape, but there was a big, wide wall in their way.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 需要逃走，可前方挡着一面又高又宽的墙。

sentences.text_en: Birch had a plan.

sentences.text_en: While he distracted the illagers, Emmy would mine her way through the wall.

sentences.text_en: It was a good plan!
sentences.zh: 这是个好办法！

pages.text_en:
Using the pickaxe, Emmy hacked away at the wall. Behind it was a secret room! Emmy and Byte entered the room. Inside, Emmy found a clump of obsidian.
Emmy used the diamond pickaxe to mine the obsidian. "This pickaxe didn't seem very useful before," she said. "But without it, I couldn't do this!"

sentences.text_en: Using the pickaxe, Emmy hacked away at the wall.
sentences.zh: Emmy 用镐子不停地凿墙。

sentences.text_en: Behind it was a secret room!
sentences.zh: 墙后面竟然是一间秘密房间！

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Byte entered the room.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Byte 走进了房间。

sentences.text_en: Inside, Emmy found a clump of obsidian.
sentences.zh: Emmy 在里面发现了一团黑曜石。

sentences.text_en: Emmy used the diamond pickaxe to mine the obsidian.

sentences.text_en: "But without it, I couldn't do this!"
sentences.zh: “可是没有它，我就做不到这些！”

pages.text_en:
There was a block of diamond inside the obsidian. Emmy used her crafting table to break the diamond block into little diamonds.
Then she used those diamonds to craft diamond swords for herself and Birch! The swords would finally protect them against the illagers.

sentences.text_en: There was a block of diamond inside the obsidian.
sentences.zh: 黑曜石里面有一块钻石方块。

sentences.text_en: Emmy used her crafting table to break the diamond block into little diamonds.
sentences.zh: Emmy 用工作台把钻石方块拆成一颗颗小钻石。

sentences.text_en: Then she used those diamonds to craft diamond swords for herself and Birch!
sentences.zh: 然后她用这些钻石给自己和 Birch 制作了钻石剑！

sentences.text_en: The swords would finally protect them against the illagers.
sentences.zh: 这些剑终于能保护他们对抗灾厄村民了。

pages.text_en:
The vindicator and evoker charged at them. Emmy hit the vindicator with her new sword. Birch swung his sword at the evoker.
Both illagers were defeated. As the evoker fell in battle, they dropped a totem of undying. Birch picked it up.

sentences.text_en: As the evoker fell in battle, they dropped a totem of undying.
sentences.zh: 唤魔者在战斗中倒下时，掉落了一枚不死图腾。

sentences.text_en: Birch picked it up.
sentences.zh: Birch 把它捡了起来。

pages.text_en:
When Emmy, Birch, Byte, and the allay left the woodland mansion, Birch was tired from the battle. Because of that, he wasn't looking where he was going and he walked off a cliff!
Luckily, Birch was holding on to the totem of undying and was unharmed. Whew! That was close!

sentences.text_en: Because of that, he wasn't looking where he was going and he walked off a cliff!

sentences.text_en: That was close!
sentences.zh: 真是有惊无险！

pages.text_en: To celebrate their victory over the illagers, the friends had a picnic in the meadow. The allay even brought them food. It was a perfect way to end the day!
